summary: An alert was triggered by an automated risk score on transaction 3660353 ($165.65) on card C07871-K1 due to activity in unfamiliar billing region 87. Investigation revealed that this transaction was the third in a sequence of consecutive in-person purchases in region 87 over three days, with zero conflicting card-present transactions in other regions. In addition, the card has no fraud ring links, the device profile shows zero fraud lift, and prior case CC-0270 established a history of cleared alerts related to legitimate travel. The alert was determined to be a false alarm caused by normal cardholder travel, and the case is closed with no fraud.
open_question: Direct customer confirmation of travel to region 87 would provide absolute verification, though the temporal clustering of card-present purchases without conflicting home transactions strongly supports legitimate travel.

last_activity.detail: Case written to graph as CASE-HHF-008

next_step: nothing waits on a person; the case is closed legitimate
